title: Canonical finite coefficient site scalar comparison
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and $X$ a scheme. Use the positive finite quotient rings of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], the etale quotient coefficient diagram of [def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow], and the intrinsic pro-etale module/scalar categories of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Define $
u_n^*$ by exact descent of the published finite constant-ring module inverse image from the small etale site to the small pro-etale site. For $n\geq m\geq1$, the ordinary scalar-restriction comparison is the canonical isomorphism $\operatorname{Res}^{\mathrm{proet}}_{n,m}\circ
u_m^*\cong
u_n^*\circ\operatorname{Res}^{\mathrm{et}}_{n,m}$, fixed by sending every image of a local section under the comparison and module-sheafification units to the same section with restricted action. Descend this same isomorphism exactly to derived categories. Define $ eta:F^{\mathrm{proet}}_{n,m}\circ
u_n^*	o
u_m^*\circ F^{\mathrm{et}}_{n,m}$ as its adjunction mate for the actual derived scalar-extension/restriction adjunctions. This prescribes the canonical coefficient/site map, including the identity quotient, rather than an arbitrary natural transformation.
